Implement the approved plan in docs/plans/add_a_json_flag_to_kodel_status_so_that_scripts_can_read_the.md.
Keep changes within the plan. Add or update tests for the changed behavior.
Follow the conventions in AGENTS.md (English only, no `any`, Biome style).

If you were sent back because of conflicts with main (the feedback lists the conflicting files,
from the sync step or from the pull request): commit your work on the run's branch
(`git add -A && git commit -s`), then `git fetch origin main && git merge --signoff origin/main`
and resolve the conflicts so that both sides' changes stay (what main added is not yours to
remove). Where the plan and main disagree, follow main and note it at the end of the plan file.
Then the checks run again. If the pull request already exists, publish only pushes to it.
